description:
Most of what goes wrong with an electric bike happens in the first three months of owning one. This channel is the buying advice and the warnings your dealer skips.

Buying guides, battery and charging safety, and the mistakes that quietly cost new riders money — for anyone getting on an e-bike for the first time, at any age.

New: The E-Bike Battery Handbook. Plain English, large print, every fact sourced, with 7 printable pages. Start with the free battery fire safety card, no email needed: https://ebike-battery-handbook.netlify.app/?ref=kanaal
